orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sharad Kumar Sharma
orders.text:
WPSS No. 698 of 2020
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
(Via Video Conferencing)
Mr. Pankaj Sharma, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. P.S. Bisht, Standing Counsel for 
the State of Uttarakhand/respondent Nos. 1 to 
5. 
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for 
respondent No.6. 
In pursuance to the previous order 
passed by this Court in Writ Petition No. 610 
of 2015 (S/S), on 24.04.2018, whereby, the 
petitioner has raised claim for grant of family 
pension, as a consequence of the death of her 
husband, who was working as Toll Moharir. 
The petitioner submits that the 
stipulation provided in the judgment dated 
24.04.2018, to entitle her for the grant of 
family pension, she has complied the same, 
but still, the respondents by virtue of the 
impugned order under challenge, had denied 
grant of family pension. 
The matter requires scrutiny. 
Let counter affidavit be filed by the 
respondents within a period of two weeks
from today. 
List this Writ Petition immediately after 
two weeks. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
Dated 17.07.2020
Shiv

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No. 698 of 2020
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Mr. Pankaj Sharma, Advocate for 
the petitioner. 
Mrs. Mamta Bisht, Deputy Advocate 
General for the State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for 
respondent no. 6.
Heard learned counsel for the 
parties.
Petitioner’s husband was a member 
of Palika Centralized Services, who died 
on 14.12.2001. Since Family Pension 
has not been sanctioned so far, 
therefore, this writ petition has been 
filed.
Learned counsel for Nagar Palika 
Parishad has referred to Rule 7 of Palika 
Non-Centralized Service Retirement 
Benefit Rules, 1984 in support of his 
contention that since petitioner’s 
husband had not deposited ` 5,000/- at 
the relevant time for becoming member 
of the Family Pension, therefore, 
petitioner cannot be given benefit under 
the said Rules. However, learned 
counsel for the petitioner submits that a 
sum of ` 5,000/- has to be deposited 
upon sanction of the Family Pension, 
therefore, petitioner cannot be denied 
Family Pension because her husband did 
not deposit ` 5,000/-.
There appears to be some 
substance in the contention made on 
behalf of the petitioner. 
In such view of the matter, list this 
matter on 11.05.2022, on which day,  Executive Officer, Nagar Palika Parishad, 
Pithoragarh shall remain present before 
this Court alongwith entire record. 
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.) 
28.04.2022
Arpan

In sequel to order dated 
28.04.2022, Executive Officer, Nagar 
Palika Parishad, Pithoragarh is present in 
Court today, however, he could not offer 
any satisfactory explanation for not 
granting family pension to the petitioner. 
Learned counsel appearing for 
Nagar Palika Parishad, however, has 
referred to certain documents, which are 
not on record. He prays for and is 
granted a week’s time to file 
supplementary affidavit, bringing on 
record all relevant documents.
List this matter on 23.05.2022. 
Personal appearance of Executive 
Officer, Nagar Palika Parishad, 
Pithoragarh is dispensed with.
(Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
